┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    EMPLOYEE RESIGNATION LIFECYCLE                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

    ACTIVE_EMPLOYEE
           │
           │ Employee submits resignation
           ▼
    RESIGNATION_REQUESTED ────────┐
           │                       │
           │ Auto-notify manager   │ Employee can withdraw
           ▼                       │
    MANAGER_REVIEW                 │
           │                       │
           ├─── Approve ──────────►│
           ├─── Request Discussion │
           └─── Reject ────────────┤
                                   │
           ▼                       │
    HR_REVIEW                      │
           │                       │
           ├─── Approve ──────────►│
           └─── Reject ────────────┤
                                   │
           ▼                       │
    OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS        │
           │                       │
           │ Checklist execution   │
           │ (Multiple tasks)      │
           ▼                       │
    FINAL_CLEARANCE                │
           │                       │
           │ All items completed   │
           ▼                       │
    COMPLETED ◄────────────────────┘
           │
           ▼
    FORMER_EMPLOYEE
    (System access disabled)

    ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 1: Employee Submits Resignation                         │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Employee Action:
├─ Opens resignation form
├─ Fills required fields:
│  ├─ Last Working Day (date picker)
│  ├─ Resignation Reason (dropdown)
│  │  └─ Options: Better Opportunity, Career Growth, 
│     │           Relocation, Personal, Health, Education,
│     │           Retirement, Culture, Compensation, etc.
│  ├─ Detailed Explanation (text area)
│  └─ Optional: Upload attachments (resignation letter)
│
└─ Clicks "Submit Resignation"

System Actions:
├─ Validates notice period
│  └─ Example: If notice period = 30 days, last working day 
│              must be >= 30 days from today
│
├─ Creates Resignation record with status: RESIGNATION_REQUESTED
├─ Updates Employee status: ACTIVE_EMPLOYEE → RESIGNATION_REQUESTED
├─ Creates first Audit Log entry
├─ Locks certain employee profile fields (prevent changes)
├─ Sends notifications:
│  ├─ To Manager: "Your employee [Name] has submitted resignation"
│  └─ To HR: "New resignation submitted - [Employee Name]"
│
└─ Displays confirmation to employee

Status: RESIGNATION_REQUESTED
Who can act: Manager, HR (Employee can withdraw)


┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 2: Manager Reviews Resignation                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Manager receives notification and opens resignation details

Manager sees:
├─ Employee information
├─ Last working day
├─ Resignation reason
├─ Employee's comments
└─ Attachments (if any)

Manager has 3 options:

OPTION A: APPROVE
├─ Manager clicks "Approve"
├─ System prompts for optional comments
├─ System actions:
│  ├─ Update status: RESIGNATION_REQUESTED → HR_REVIEW
│  ├─ Log: "Manager approved on [date]"
│  ├─ Notify HR: "Resignation approved by manager, awaiting HR review"
│  └─ Notify Employee: "Your manager has approved your resignation"

OPTION B: REQUEST DISCUSSION
├─ Manager clicks "Request Discussion"
├─ Manager enters reason/comments
├─ System actions:
│  ├─ Status remains: MANAGER_REVIEW
│  ├─ Flag: discussion_requested = true
│  ├─ Notify Employee: "Your manager wants to discuss your resignation"
│  └─ Employee can still withdraw or wait for manager's final decision

OPTION C: REJECT
├─ Manager clicks "Reject"
├─ Manager must provide reason
├─ System actions:
│  ├─ Update status: RESIGNATION_REQUESTED → COMPLETED (Rejected)
│  ├─ Revert Employee status: RESIGNATION_REQUESTED → ACTIVE_EMPLOYEE
│  ├─ Log rejection with reason
│  └─ Notify Employee: "Your resignation was not approved"

Status after approval: HR_REVIEW
Who can act: HR (Employee can still withdraw)


┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 3: HR Reviews and Confirms Resignation                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

HR receives notification and opens resignation

HR reviews:
├─ Employment contract details
├─ Notice period compliance
├─ Pending leave balances
├─ Outstanding dues
├─ Manager's approval and comments
└─ Company policies

HR has 3 options:

OPTION A: APPROVE (Most Common)
├─ HR clicks "Approve Resignation"
├─ HR confirms/adjusts last working day if needed
├─ System actions:
│  ├─ Update status: HR_REVIEW → OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS
│  ├─ Update Employee status: HR_REVIEW → OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS
│  ├─ 🎯 TRIGGER: Generate Offboarding Checklist (see Phase 4)
│  ├─ Schedule exit interview
│  ├─ Send formal resignation acknowledgment email
│  ├─ Notify:
│  │  ├─ Employee: "Your resignation is approved, offboarding begins"
│  │  ├─ Manager: "Offboarding process started for [Employee]"
│  │  ├─ IT: "Schedule access revocation for [Last Working Day]"
│  │  ├─ Finance: "Process final payroll for [Employee]"
│  │  └─ Admin: "Schedule asset collection"
│  └─ Generate official resignation acceptance letter

OPTION B: REQUEST CLARIFICATION
├─ HR requests more information
├─ Status remains: HR_REVIEW
├─ Notify employee or manager

OPTION C: REJECT
├─ HR rejects (rare - policy violation, etc.)
├─ Status: COMPLETED (Rejected)
├─ Employee reverts to: ACTIVE_EMPLOYEE

Status after approval: OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS
Who can act: Employee, Manager, HR, IT, Finance (via checklist)


┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 4: Automated Offboarding Checklist Generation           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

When HR approves resignation, system automatically:

1. Finds applicable checklist template
   └─ Based on: Department, Position, Company policies

2. Creates Offboarding Checklist from template

3. Generates checklist items with owners and due dates

Sample Offboarding Checklist:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ OFFBOARDING CHECKLIST - John Doe (OFF-2025-00123)          │
│ Progress: 3/15 items completed (20%)                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

CATEGORY: KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER (Owner: Employee + Manager)
├─ [IN_PROGRESS] Document ongoing projects and tasks
│  └─ Due: 7 days before LWD | Assigned to: Employee
│
├─ [PENDING] Conduct handover meetings
│  └─ Due: 5 days before LWD | Assigned to: Employee
│
└─ [COMPLETED] ✓ Share access credentials and documentation
   └─ Completed by: John Doe on Jan 05, 2025

CATEGORY: ASSET RETURN (Owner: Admin/Facilities)
├─ [PENDING] Return laptop and accessories
│  └─ Due: Last Working Day | Assigned to: Employee
│
├─ [PENDING] Return access cards and keys
│  └─ Due: Last Working Day | Assigned to: Admin
│
└─ [PENDING] Return mobile phone
   └─ Due: Last Working Day | Assigned to: Employee

CATEGORY: IT & ACCESS (Owner: IT Department)
├─ [PENDING] Backup employee files to shared drive
│  └─ Due: 2 days before LWD | Assigned to: IT
│
├─ [PENDING] Schedule account deactivation
│  └─ Due: End of Last Working Day | Assigned to: IT
│
├─ [PENDING] Revoke system access (Email, Slack, etc.)
│  └─ Due: End of Last Working Day | Assigned to: IT
│
└─ [PENDING] Remove from distribution lists
   └─ Due: 1 day after LWD | Assigned to: IT

CATEGORY: HR & COMPLIANCE (Owner: HR)
├─ [COMPLETED] ✓ Schedule exit interview
│  └─ Completed by: HR Team on Jan 03, 2025
│
├─ [COMPLETED] ✓ Conduct exit interview
│  └─ Completed by: HR Manager on Jan 06, 2025
│
├─ [PENDING] Calculate final leave encashment
│  └─ Due: 3 days before LWD | Assigned to: HR
│
└─ [PENDING] Generate Certificate of Employment
   └─ Due: Last Working Day | Assigned to: HR

CATEGORY: FINANCE (Owner: Finance Department)
├─ [PENDING] Process final payroll
│  └─ Due: Next pay cycle after LWD | Assigned to: Finance
│
└─ [PENDING] Clear any outstanding dues/advances
   └─ Due: Last Working Day | Assigned to: Finance

Each checklist item has:
├─ Status: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, BLOCKED
├─ Owner: Who is responsible
├─ Due Date: Calculated from last working day
├─ Priority: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL
├─ Dependencies: Some items depend on others
└─ Comments: For updates and blockers


┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 5: Exit Interview (Part of Checklist)                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

HR schedules exit interview (usually 1 week before LWD)

Exit Interview Form:
├─ Scheduled Date & Time
├─ Conducted By (HR representative)
│
├─ STRUCTURED FEEDBACK:
│  ├─ Primary reason for leaving
│  ├─ Overall satisfaction rating (1-5)
│  ├─ Work environment rating (1-5)
│  ├─ Management rating (1-5)
│  ├─ Compensation rating (1-5)
│  ├─ Career growth opportunities rating (1-5)
│  └─ Work-life balance rating (1-5)
│
├─ OPEN FEEDBACK:
│  ├─ What did you like most about working here?
│  ├─ What did you like least?
│  ├─ Suggestions for improvement
│  ├─ Would you recommend company to others? (Yes/No)
│  └─ Would you consider returning? (Yes/No)
│
└─ Additional comments

After completion:
├─ HR marks exit interview as COMPLETED
├─ System updates checklist item
├─ Feedback stored for analytics
└─ Data used for company improvement initiatives


┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ STEP 6: Final Clearance (Last Working Day)                   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

System checks if ALL checklist items are completed:

VALIDATION:
├─ Knowledge Transfer: ✓ All completed
├─ Asset Return: ✓ All completed
├─ IT & Access: ✓ All completed
├─ HR & Compliance: ✓ All completed
└─ Finance: ✓ All completed

Progress: 15/15 items (100%)

If 100% complete:
├─ Status changes: OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS → FINAL_CLEARANCE
├─ HR receives notification: "Ready for final clearance"
│
└─ HR performs final actions:
   ├─ Reviews all completed items
   ├─ Verifies no pending dues
   ├─ Generates final documents:
   │  ├─ Certificate of Employment
   │  ├─ Final settlement statement
   │  └─ No-dues certificate
   │
   └─ Clicks "Approve Final Clearance"

System actions after final clearance:
├─ Status: FINAL_CLEARANCE → COMPLETED
├─ Employee status: OFFBOARDING_IN_PROGRESS → FORMER_EMPLOYEE
├─ Disable all system access immediately
├─ Archive employee data (for compliance)
├─ Send final email to employee:
│  └─ "Thank you for your service. Your final documents are attached."
│
└─ Close resignation record

Status: COMPLETED
Employee is now: FORMER_EMPLOYEE


🎭 User Roles & Permissions
1. EMPLOYEE (Resigning Person)
Can do:
├─ Submit resignation
├─ Upload resignation letter
├─ View own resignation status
├─ Complete assigned checklist items (knowledge transfer)
├─ Withdraw resignation (before manager approval)
├─ Participate in exit interview
└─ View own offboarding progress

Cannot do:
├─ Approve/reject any resignation
├─ Modify system dates
├─ Access others' resignations
└─ Edit locked profile fields after submission
2. MANAGER (Employee's Direct Supervisor)
Can do:
├─ View subordinates' resignations
├─ Approve resignation
├─ Reject resignation (with reason)
├─ Request discussion with employee
├─ Add comments
├─ Complete manager-assigned checklist items
├─ View offboarding progress of subordinates
└─ Receive notifications

Cannot do:
├─ Submit resignation on behalf of employee
├─ Skip HR review
├─ Access other managers' team resignations
└─ Modify final settlement
3. HR (Human Resources)
Can do:
├─ View ALL resignations (company-wide)
├─ Approve/reject resignations
├─ Modify last working day
├─ Generate offboarding checklists
├─ Schedule/conduct exit interviews
├─ Approve final clearance
├─ Generate employment certificates
├─ View resignation analytics
├─ Manage checklist templates
├─ Override checklist items (if necessary)
└─ Access historical data

This is the highest permission level.
4. IT DEPARTMENT
Can do:
├─ View assigned checklist items
├─ Complete IT-related tasks:
│  ├─ Backup employee files
│  ├─ Schedule access revocation
│  └─ Remove from distribution lists
└─ Receive notifications for IT tasks

Cannot do:
├─ View salary/compensation details
├─ Approve/reject resignations
└─ Access exit interview feedback
5. FINANCE
Can do:
├─ View assigned checklist items
├─ Process final payroll
├─ Calculate leave encashment
├─ Clear outstanding dues
└─ Generate final settlement

Cannot do:
├─ Approve/reject resignations
├─ Modify resignation dates
└─ Access exit interview feedback

🔔 Notification System
NOTIFICATION TRIGGERS:

1. Resignation Submitted
   └─ Notify: Manager, HR

2. Manager Approved
   └─ Notify: Employee, HR

3. Manager Rejected
   └─ Notify: Employee, HR

4. Manager Requests Discussion
   └─ Notify: Employee

5. HR Approved
   └─ Notify: Employee, Manager, IT, Finance, Admin

6. Offboarding Started
   └─ Notify: All checklist owners with their tasks

7. Checklist Item Overdue
   └─ Notify: Item owner, HR

8. Exit Interview Scheduled
   └─ Notify: Employee, HR

9. All Items Completed
   └─ Notify: HR (ready for final clearance)

10. Final Clearance Approved
    └─ Notify: Employee (with final documents)

📈 System Benefits
For Employees:

✅ Clear, transparent process
✅ Track resignation status in real-time
✅ Know exactly what's needed from them
✅ Smooth exit experience

For Managers:

✅ Quick approval workflow
✅ Option to discuss retention
✅ Visibility into knowledge transfer
✅ Track team turnover

For HR:

✅ Centralized resignation management
✅ Automated checklist generation
✅ Exit interview analytics
✅ Compliance and audit trail
✅ Reduce manual work

For Company:

✅ Standardized offboarding process
✅ Protect intellectual property (knowledge transfer)
✅ Recover company assets
✅ Learn from employee feedback
✅ Reduce security risks (timely access revocation)
✅ Maintain positive employer brand
